verdict.rationale: ELSTER's own docs say any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit through the same rail (elster-supp-2, elster-docs-2), using a certificate that allows electronic submission without a signature (elster-docs-7, elster-supp-1). That implies a sanctioned non-interactive submission channel, though the evidence never describes headless or CI operation directly, and the ERiC developer-artifact host timed out on the latest probe (elster-probe-1). The consumer-facing product itself is a guided web/app UI (elster-docs-10, elster-docs-18). Missing for 10: documented headless/CLI or API usage, CI/automation guidance, a reachable developer SDK channel, and any hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
